name: Hesperian-Donjon
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an ancient meteor crater, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
